changeSet.author: knowledgebase-dev
changeSet.comment: Rebuildable pgvector chunks and leased indexing queue; enable with spring.liquibase.contexts=rag.
changeSet.sql: CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS vector; CREATE TABLE rag_chunks ( document_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES documents(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, space_id BIGINT NOT NULL, version_sha VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, source_updated_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, chunk_index INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (chunk_index >= 0), chunk_text TEXT NOT NULL, embedding_model VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, embedding_dimensions INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (embedding_dimensions BETWEEN 1 AND 16000), embedding vector NOT NULL, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, PRIMARY KEY (document_id, version_sha, embedding_model, embedding_dimensions, chunk_index), CHECK (vector_dims(embedding) = embedding_dimensions) ); CREATE INDEX idx_rag_chunks_model_document ON rag_chunks(embedding_model, embedding_dimensions, document_id); CREATE TABLE rag_index_jobs ( document_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES documents(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, space_id BIGINT NOT NULL, version_sha VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, git_file_path VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL, source_updated_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, embedding_model VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, embedding_dimensions INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (embedding_dimensions BETWEEN 1 AND 16000), state VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL CHECK (state IN ('PENDING', 'PROCESSING', 'DONE', 'FAILED')), attempts INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, available_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, lease_until TIMESTAMPTZ, lease_token VARCHAR(36), last_error VARCHAR(80), updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, PRIMARY KEY (document_id, embedding_model, embedding_dimensions) ); CREATE INDEX idx_rag_jobs_available ON rag_index_jobs(state, available_at); CREATE TABLE rag_embedding_budget ( budget_day DATE PRIMARY KEY, used_characters BIGINT NOT NULL CHECK (used_characters >= 0) );
